Preview: The test is real. The motive behind it is where things get slippery.

---

Words I like;
Free isn't free when the guy holding the test kit also holds a commission check.
Let me save you a headache. When a company knocks on your door offering a free in-home water test, understand what's happening. Most of those tests are theater. They drop a chemical in your glass, it turns purple or foamy, and suddenly you're staring at "proof" you need to buy something today.
Here's the truth. Real water testing gives you numbers. Hardness in grains per gallon. Iron in parts per million. pH. Chlorine. Nitrates if you're on a well. A drop that changes color tells you almost nothing except that a reaction happened. Any water does that. Even good water does that.
A trustworthy test tells you what's in your water and how much. Then it lets YOU decide, on your own time, with no pressure to sign before the guy leaves your kitchen.

# Competitor Intel Brief — 2026-08-04

# Section 1 — Executive Summary

Only three competitor snapshots were populated this week (Mermaid, EcoWater, Hampton Roads); the remaining five in the brief were empty, so this read is partial. The sharpest local threat remains Mermaid, which is aggressively stacking promo offers ($200 off heaters, $100 first-service, free Kinetico install, free heater flush) and bundling plumbing + water treatment under one roof in NoVA. Hampton Roads is leaning hard on a "Lifetime Warranty" + free water test angle and covers both Tidewater and Richmond. No competitor showed meaningful week-over-week change (prior snapshots were identical), so this is a positioning/promo-intensity story, not a shift story.

# Section 2 — Per-competitor table

| Competitor | Hero positioning (one phrase) | Distinct services | Pricing visible? | Notable shift this week |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mermaid Water | "Test first, install right, stand behind the work" (water + plumbing) | Kinetico systems, full plumbing, pumps/pressure, commercial (DI/RO), well & septic | Yes — discounts, not prices ($200, $100, free install/flush) | None vs. prior; heavy rotating promo carousel is the standout |
| EcoWater | "Better water starts here" — global leader, free water test | Softeners, filtration, smart-home leak/conservation tech, third-party certified | No prices; free water test offer | None vs. prior; symptom-based ("if you have…") diagnostic funnel |
| Hampton Roads Water Services | "Full service water quality experts" — peace of mind | Water testing, hard water, bacteria/virus, contaminant treatment; USA-made systems | No prices; free water test | None vs. prior; pushes Lifetime Warranty + annual test booking |
| (5 others) | — no snapshot data provided — | — | — | Snapshots empty this week |

# Section 3 — Implications for ClearWave

- **Counter Mermaid's promo stack:** they're winning the "reason to act now" battle with 4 concrete offers. Test a comparable limited-time bundle (e.g., free install or first-service credit) rather than competing on vague "quality."
- **Borrow the diagnostic funnel + free test:** all three lead with symptom-based, low-friction "free water test." If ClearWave isn't leading with this on the hero, add it — it's table stakes in this market.
- **Own the warranty/trust axis:** Hampton Roads leans on "Lifetime Warranty" and Mermaid on "test first, licensed techs, stand behind the work." ClearWave should sharpen one ownable trust claim (warranty terms, guarantee, or VA-local credibility) and put it above the fold.

# Section 4 — Watch items

- **Re-pull the 5 missing competitors** — this week's snapshots were empty; get real data before drawing conclusions on the full set.
- **Mermaid promo rotation** — track whether the $200/$100/free-install offers persist, expire, or escalate (signals seasonal push into fall).
- **Hampton Roads geographic creep** — they advertise both Hampton Roads and Richmond numbers; watch for any NoVA expansion language.
- **EcoWater smart-home/leak-detection push** — if they elevate conservation/leak tech, that's a potential new competitive service line to evaluate.
